native_evidence.finding: Unless the newspaper-to-trash option succeeds, the morning newspaper uses AddDirectSellingItemToTable(newspaper, isOwend:true). This is the same front-counter placement path used by the seed supplier.
The front selling counter is initialized as a distinct 18-by-4 GameGridInventory.
Merchant dialogue end action populates physical goods by repeated AddDirectSellingItemToTable calls, without retaining failed offers through those calls.

String overload skips an offer when front counter CanTakeAnything is false. Instantiated-item overload invokes GraphUtils.TryAcceptAllOrDestroy and returns false if unplaced. Void AddDirectSellingItemToTable wrappers discard the bool return.
An unplaced item is logged and destroyed. There is no deferred merchant stock ledger in this placement path.
Cash is deducted during purchase. The failed initial offer placement discussed here occurs before purchase. Do not generalize this finding to unverified post-purchase failure cases.

recommended_initial_scope: User subsequently selected a separate NPC, 鹈鹕镇的农夫, visiting immediately after the weekly retired farmer. Retain guaranteed stock totals and deferred physical display for the new NPC; automatic scaling remains undecided.
separate_npc_capacity_finding: Native departure cleanup removes unsold unowned goods from both counters. Existing owned goods and newspapers remain, so the new NPC still requires capacity-safe delivery.
proposed_delivery_requirements: Retain quantities for mod seed offers that have not yet been placed on the counter
Try to display only what fits; reduce pending stock only after successful placement
Retry while the same merchant is present after space becomes available; keep stock and physical offers consistent
Keep seed offers unowned until normal purchase; do not bypass payment by moving failed offers into player storage
Do not delete or move the player's newspapers or owned items to make room
No new full quota on repeated dialogue or save reload during the same visit
Unpurchased pending stock ends with the merchant visit, following ordinary visit availability
required_future_game_checks: Front counter completely full of owned items including newspapers
Only one usable seed slot left
Fragmented free space and shape-sensitive placement
Space freed by buying or moving items while merchant remains present
Repeated dialogue, saving/loading, and merchant departure
Check both missing offers and accidental duplicate or free offers
limits: This review inspected code only. No mod-4 implementation or live full-counter verification has been performed.
